tess (PM): Heads-up 1: I've posted a new compact roles prototype that pairs role selection + invite step and surfaces SSO enforcement inline. Can we do a quick pass on keyboard flow and copy before we ship? figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-roles-v2

kai (Designer): Quick take: layout is much tighter which is great for power users. Concern: SSO enforcement is now a tiny badge under the role name. On quick scans it looks like metadata, not an actionable policy.

lee (Frontend): I noticed that too. Also the badge is not reachable by tab currently (it's decorative span). If we make it interactive (tooltip / explain), we need to ensure it's in tab order without adding noise.

marta (Backend): No technical blockers for showing enforcement at invite-time. We'll need to support `role_sso_required` in the invite endpoint so frontend can validate before submit. We can return 422 with code `role_requires_sso` or preflight check.

tess (PM): Preference is preflight validation so we can show inline before the user hits send. If backend adds the flag to /roles list, frontend can disable roles or show the validation earlier.

noa (a11y): Accessibility items: 1) The small badge text contrast is ~2.8:1 on light bg. Needs higher contrast. 2) Screen reader should announce when choosing a role that enforces SSO: something like "Selected role: Billing Admin. Requires SSO." 3) The invite modal's "View audit" link should be accessible and focused when deep-linking from a toast.

kai (Designer): I'll update the badge style to use a filled pill with 4.5:1 contrast and add an info button (16px, aria-label). Copy options for the pill: "SSO only", "Requires SSO", "Enforced: SSO". Thoughts?

lee (Frontend): Short + clear is best for small UI. I vote for "SSO only" as it's compact. But for the tooltip we can expand to full sentence: "Users must sign in via SSO for this role." Also will add role list keyboard row focus.

noa (a11y): "SSO only" reads fine. For SR announce, use `aria-describedby` pointing to the live region when role is selected. Also ensure the info button has `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and opens a modal with heading and close button keyboard focus trap.

marta (Backend): About deep-linking to audit: we can accept query params like `?highlight=invite:12345` where 12345 is an event id or the invite request id. We'll need frontend to pass a stable id. API will return the event id on invite creation.

tess (PM): Great. UX detail: when we deep-link from the modal's "View audit" we should land on audit with filters applied and scroll to the invite entry. If possible add a short label in audit like "From invite modal" so users know context. Keep motion subtle.

kai (Designer): For visual highlight I'm thinking a 1.5s subtle amber fade + dark outline for focus state. We'll respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. We'll also add a small chip near the filters: "Context: Invite modal" when deep-linked.

lee (Frontend): Implementation plan: 1) update roles GET to include `sso_required` flag (useful across the app), 2) make badge tabbable and add info-button modal, 3) add `aria-live` region updates on role selection, 4) deep-link handler on audit page to parse `highlight` and `context` params and focus the matched entry.

noa (a11y): Tests: keyboard-only walkthrough, screen reader walkthrough for role selection, and a contrast check. Also test that the modal close returns focus to the info button.

marta (Backend): I'll add `sso_required` to roles payload and event id to invite response by EOD. Returning 422 on submit if there's a mismatch as a safety net. Error code: `SSO_ROLE_REQUIRED`.

tess (PM): Nice. Timeline: Kai updates figma today, Lee starts PR for badge + focus + live region tomorrow, Marta updates API today, Noa will run a quick-a11y pass once PR is ready. Deploy-bot: flagged as UI tweak only.

deploy-bot: note: change categorized as UI/UX small; no infra rollout needed.

kai (Designer): Uploaded new frames: https://figma.com/file/compact-roles-v2?node-id=12:0 1 1 - badge is now a filled pill, info button added, and invite CTA order updated.

lee (Frontend): Will post draft PR link when available.

tess (PM): Thanks team. If anyone spots edge cases (bulk invites, CSV flows) call it out here.
